meta.rationale: A radar scope sweeps round and round; your apps are the contacts it picks up. Click a blip to bring it in.
meta.theme-about: radar scope: a full-screen canvas of a round green radar display filling the middle of a dark instrument panel (range rings, bearing ticks and numbers, a rotating sweep with a fading afterglow trail), each app a blip at its own bearing and range that flares when the sweep passes, labelled in small caps, the blip under the pointer gets a lock box; a riveted metal side panel on the right with the time, a bearing readout and big toggle buttons. Military, submarine, analogue. (#scope, #panel)

desktop.canvas: local blips, hot = {}, nil function draw(w, h, t) g.rect(0, 0, w, h, "#0d110e") local cx, cy = (w - 300) / 2, h / 2 local R = math.min(cx, cy) - 40 g.circle(cx, cy, R + 18, "#2a302b") g.circle(cx, cy, R + 6, "#050805") g.circle(cx, cy, R, "#031a06") for k = 1, 4 do g.arc(cx, cy, R * k / 4, 0, 6.29, "rgba(92,255,92,0.25)", 1) end g.line(cx - R, cy, cx + R, cy, "rgba(92,255,92,0.2)", 1) g.line(cx, cy - R, cx, cy + R, "rgba(92,255,92,0.2)", 1) for i = 0, 35 do local a = i / 36 * 6.283 - 1.5708 g.line(cx + math.cos(a) * (R - 10), cy + math.sin(a) * (R - 10), cx + math.cos(a) * R, cy + math.sin(a) * R, "rgba(92,255,92,0.6)", 1.5) g.text(cx + math.cos(a) * (R + 28) - 10, cy + math.sin(a) * (R + 28) - 8, string.format("%03d", i * 10), "#6f8f6a", 11, "JetBrainsMono") end local sw = (t * 0.9) % 6.283 for k = 0, 18 do local a0 = sw - k * 0.035 g.poly({cx, cy, cx + math.cos(a0) * R, cy + math.sin(a0) * R, cx + math.cos(a0 - 0.04) * R, cy + math.sin(a0 - 0.04) * R}, string.format("rgba(92,255,92,%.3f)", 0.28 * (1 - k / 18))) end g.line(cx, cy, cx + math.cos(sw) * R, cy + math.sin(sw) * R, "#9dff9d", 2) local apps = g.apps() local px, py, over = g.pointer() blips, hot = {}, nil for i, a in ipairs(apps) do local bear = (i * 2.399) % 6.283 local range = R * (0.3 + ((i * 0.173) % 0.6)) local x, y = cx + math.cos(bear) * range, cy + math.sin(bear) * range local since = (sw - bear) % 6.283 blips[#blips + 1] = {x = x, y = y, glow = math.max(0.25, 1 - since / 4), name = a.name, id = a.id} end for _, b in ipairs(blips) do if over and (px - b.x) ^ 2 + (py - b.y) ^ 2 < 24 * 24 then hot = b.id end end for _, b in ipairs(blips) do g.glow(b.x, b.y, 22, string.format("rgba(92,255,92,%.2f)", b.glow * 0.6)) g.circle(b.x, b.y, 5, string.format("rgba(180,255,180,%.2f)", b.glow)) g.text(b.x + 12, b.y - 8, b.name, string.format("rgba(160,255,160,%.2f)", 0.4 + b.glow * 0.6), 13, "JetBrainsMono") if b.id == hot then g.rect(b.x - 16, b.y - 16, 32, 1.5, "#ffb347") g.rect(b.x - 16, b.y + 15, 32, 1.5, "#ffb347") g.rect(b.x - 16, b.y - 16, 1.5, 32, "#ffb347") g.rect(b.x + 15, b.y - 16, 1.5, 32, "#ffb347") end end end function click(x, y) for _, b in ipairs(blips) do if (x - b.x) ^ 2 + (y - b.y) ^ 2 < 24 * 24 then return "open:" .. b.id end end end
